title: Fourier coefficient of an empirical density
statement: Let $m>0$, let $x_0,\ldots,x_{m-1}$ be a list of samples from the $n$-dimensional binary cube, and let $\gamma$ be another point of that cube. The vector Fourier coefficient of the density assigning mass according to these samples equals the empirical mean, over the $m$ samples, of the Walsh character indexed by $\gamma$.
hypotheses_covered: The samples form a map from $\{0,\ldots,m-1\}$ to the $n$-dimensional binary cube
